page.layout: One page: a running head and page number at the top, then three parallel columns of abbreviation tables (Greek forms with their Latin expansions), set in lines with no headings. Each column is read top to bottom, left to right. A small mark stands at the lower right below the last line.
page.notes: Greek abbreviation forms are rendered approximately; many letters in the scan are worn or ligatured and each uncertain form is marked [?]. The first-column entries of the first rows and several Greek forms in columns one and two could not be read letter by letter and should be checked against the original. The small mark at the lower right below the last line is not clearly a catchword or signature and is left out. The tables are not clearly set against the printed Greek, so the middle column's third-row and later forms are the least certain.
